**One issue I found and fixed before the PR:**

In `ColorsStep.tsx`, the imports for `PanelTwoColor` and `PanelTwoColorPalette` were deleted while the JSX was only commented out. Those components are still actively used in `SummaryStep`, `DoorModelSharedSummary`, `usePanels`, and `selectors` — so if anyone uncomments the JSX later, the missing imports would cause an immediate build error. I added the imports back as comments so restoring them is a one-line change.
